title: rigiolepis lanceolata f. sumatrana
intro: Rigiolepis lanceolata f. sumatrana, commonly known as Sumatran Rigolepis, is a plant species that belongs to the family Hernandiaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Sumatran Rigolepis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are believed to aid in the treatment of wounds, fever, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties.
